Feature: One-command local stack
User Story: As a developer I want one command to start the data plane so that anyone can run Prognos locally

Feature: Replicated durable messaging
User Story: As a platform engineer I want telemetry to survive a broker failure so that no events are lost

Feature: Multi-tenant relational core (3NF)
User Story: As a fleet manager I want my fleet data isolated from other customers so that it is never exposed or corrupted

Feature: Telemetry store with duplicate-safe rollups
User Story: As a fleet manager I want vehicle history kept for trend analysis so that slow degradation is visible

Feature: Deterministic 100K-vehicle synthetic fleet
User Story: As a platform engineer I want a reproducible 100K-vehicle dataset so that every benchmark is repeatable

Feature: VIN and DTC validation
User Story: As a platform engineer I want malformed identifiers rejected so that bad OEM data never reaches analytics

Feature: Append-only audit log
User Story: As a DPO I want an immutable record of data access so that accountability can be demonstrated

Feature: Scalable multi-OEM telemetry simulator
User Story: As a platform engineer I want realistic 100K-vehicle telemetry in three OEM formats so that the pipeline is tested against real-world variety and scale

Feature: Fault injection with ground truth
User Story: As a data scientist I want known failure onset and failure times so that predictions can be evaluated honestly

Feature: Delivery anomaly injection (duplicates / out-of-order / malformed / missing)
User Story: As a platform engineer I want realistic bad data so that validation, dedup and DLQ are proven

Feature: Multi-OEM normalisation to a canonical event
User Story: As a platform engineer I want every OEM format mapped to one schema so that downstream logic is written once

Feature: Validation with dead-letter queue
User Story: As a platform engineer I want invalid payloads quarantined with a reason so that bad data never reaches analytics and can be replayed

Feature: Exact duplicate suppression with out-of-order tolerance
User Story: As a fleet manager I want each event counted once so that alerts and costs are not double counted

Feature: Critical real-time alerts (< 5 s)
User Story: As a fleet manager I want to know within seconds when a vehicle overheats or breaks down so that I can act before damage spreads

Feature: Early-warning trend detection
User Story: As a fleet manager I want warnings days before a breakdown so that repairs can be planned

Feature: Tyre leak rate and time-to-critical estimate
User Story: As a fleet manager I want to know how long a leaking tyre can keep running so that I can schedule the fix

Feature: Detection back-test harness
User Story: As a data scientist I want to score detection against ground truth so that every change to rules or models is measured

Feature: Telemetry history in ClickHouse via Kafka engine
User Story: As an analyst I want every event stored for trend analysis so that history is complete

Feature: Idempotent alert persistence
User Story: As a fleet manager I want each alert recorded once with its lifecycle so that I can act on and audit it

Feature: Live vehicle state and at-risk ranking in Redis
User Story: As a fleet manager I want a live view ranked by risk so that I see the worst vehicles first

Feature: End-to-end no-data-loss reconciliation
User Story: As a platform engineer I want proof that nothing is lost between Kafka and the stores so that the brief's no-loss requirement is evidenced

Feature: Calibrated failure risk per rule
User Story: As a fleet manager I want each warning to say how likely and how soon a failure is so that I can compare vehicles

Feature: Cost-aware prioritisation (no fabricated money)
User Story: As a finance owner I want vehicles ranked by expected cost avoided only when the costs are real so that no decision rests on invented figures

Feature: Capacity-aware work-order proposals with audit trail
User Story: As a workshop planner I want proposed bookings that respect daily capacity and the failure deadline so that the most valuable repairs happen first

Feature: Emerging-fault radar (firmware / model cohorts)
User Story: As an OEM quality engineer I want to know when one firmware or model shows a DTC far more often than its peers so that a systematic defect is caught before it spreads

Feature: Backfill training dataset from the production pipeline
User Story: As a data scientist I want training data produced by the same normalizer and detector as the live system so that the model learns what it will see in production

Feature: Leak-free window features (DuckDB over Parquet)
User Story: As a data scientist I want features that only use the past so that offline results hold in production

Feature: 7-day failure model vs rule baseline on held-out data
User Story: As a fleet manager I want a better at-risk list than the rules so that workshop slots go to vehicles that will really fail

Feature: Per-prediction explanations and versioned model artefact
User Story: As a fleet manager I want to see why a vehicle is flagged so that I trust and can challenge the list

Feature: Secure login and tokens (RS256 JWT + JWKS; argon2id; brute-force guard)
User Story: As a fleet manager I want a secure login so that only my staff see my fleet

Feature: Role-based access and tenant isolation with audit of denials
User Story: As a data owner I want each role to see only what it needs and no tenant to see another so that data is protected

Feature: Fleet REST API (vehicles; alerts; work-order lifecycle) with keyset pagination
User Story: As a dashboard developer I want stable paginated endpoints so that the UI stays fast at 100K vehicles

Feature: Live alert feed over WebSocket
User Story: As a fleet manager I want new alerts pushed to my screen so that I react within seconds

Feature: Live model scoring with training/serving parity and a data gate
User Story: As a data scientist I want production scores computed exactly like training features so that offline results carry over

Feature: Shadow deployment of the model (rules stay in charge until validated)
User Story: As a fleet manager I want the model introduced safely so that an unvalidated model never drives bookings

Feature: Fleet dashboard: summary; at-risk list with rules/model toggle; map
User Story: As a fleet manager I want one screen that shows which vehicles need attention and where so that I can act in seconds

Feature: Live alerts view with acknowledge
User Story: As a fleet manager I want new alerts to appear without refreshing so that nothing is missed

Feature: Work-order board with role-aware lifecycle actions
User Story: As a workshop planner I want to schedule, start and complete work orders so that repairs are tracked to an outcome

Feature: Vehicle detail with plain-language model reasons
User Story: As a fleet manager I want to know why a vehicle is flagged so that I can trust or challenge it

Feature: SLOs with multi-window burn-rate alerts and runbooks
User Story: As an operator I want to be paged only when users are affected so that alerts are trusted

Feature: Service-health dashboard generated from code
User Story: As an operator I want one screen that shows which pipeline stage is failing so that I can act fast

Feature: Structured JSON logs with request ids
User Story: As an operator I want to follow one request through the logs and audit log so that I can explain a failure

Feature: Failure drill: detect a lost service and recover from the backlog
User Story: As an operator I want proof that outages are detected so that I can rely on the monitoring

Feature: PostgreSQL row-level security as a second tenant barrier
User Story: As a fleet customer I want my data isolated even if the application has a bug so that competitors never see it

Feature: Right-to-erasure workflow (DPO request + worker across PostgreSQL / ClickHouse / Redis)
User Story: As a data protection officer I want to erase a driver's or vehicle's personal data and prove it so that the fleet meets privacy law

Feature: STRIDE threat model with controls mapped to tests
User Story: As a security reviewer I want every threat tied to a control and a test so that claims can be checked

Feature: Security headers and loopback-only ports
User Story: As an operator I want safe defaults so that a laptop demo does not expose data

Feature: Dependency and secret scanning gate
User Story: As a maintainer I want vulnerable dependencies and leaked secrets to fail the build so that they never ship

Feature: Measured SQL optimisation of the three slowest queries
User Story: As a fleet manager I want the dashboard to load instantly even with years of alert history so that I can act without waiting
